previous_catalog_record.summary: 8-walled grid (border + 1-2 dividers, optional gaps) with rooms holding one seed color each — sometimes several seeds of that color, sometimes a two-color room that stays unfilled, sometimes an empty room; rule floods each room with its unique seed color.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: A per-room table of seed-color counts, total seed count, and the strict-majority winner (or no winner).
sequential_dependency.step_a: Partition the input at color-8 walls, then count every nonzero seed color inside each four-connected room.
sequential_dependency.step_b: For each room, consume that count table and fill only zero cells with the winner when its count is strictly more than half of all seeds.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The fill gate and paint color are not available from wall geometry or first-seed order; they are determined by the counts produced in Step A. A minority-first room changes color under the first-seed ablation.

parametric_work.summary: Two settings, exact canonical default, 2–6 demos, seed-shuffled four-query bank, 30x30 stress, protected-Racket labels, named shortcut rejection, and causal replay.

target_report.summary: Repaired the ordinary three-demo teaching schedule to force mixed/twin gate coverage, then added an exact-default unique_color/strict_majority native family.
